Little Lumi, a firefly so bright,
Flew out one lovely, starry night.
Her light was tiny, a sweet little spark,
Flying away from the meadow dark.

She flew past flowers, so red and so blue,
Covered in morning dew.
A little cloud came, big and gray,
And Lumi felt scared to stay.

She wished for magic, with all of her might,
To keep her glowing, shiny light!
Then, WHOOSH! A rainbow, a colorful band,
Appeared and touched her with a magic hand.

The rainbow gave Lumi a coat of star-dust,
Helping her to shine, because she MUST.
Now braver than ever, she zipped through the air,
Leaving glittery sparkles everywhere.

A little sad now, remembering the dark,
Lumi took courage like a tiny lark.
She saw other fireflies, blinking near,
And knew she wasn’t alone, no need to fear.

They twinkled together, a luminous crew,
"The Brave Little Firefly," shiny and new.
Lumi smiled then, happy and free,
A magical firefly, for all to see.
